config.script:
from shared import tagsTree
	try:
		paths = tagsTree.getHistoricalTags()
		tree = tagsTree.createTree(paths)
	except Exception as e:
		system.util.getLogger("AdhocTrend").warn("Historized tag tree failed: %s" % str(e))
		tree = []
	self.props.items = tree

from shared import tagsTree
	showing = not self.view.custom.treeVisible
	self.view.custom.treeVisible = showing
	tree = self.parent.parent.parent.parent.getChild("TagTree").getChild("Tree")
	tree.props.selection = []
	tree.props.selectionData = []
	# Rebuild historized tree when opening (no view.custom.treeItems cache)
	if showing:
		tree.props.items = tagsTree.createTree(tagsTree.getHistoricalTags())

from shared import Alerts
	faceplate = False
	try:
		faceplate = bool(self.view.params.faceplateMode)
	except:
		faceplate = False
	if faceplate:
		Alerts.showAdhocTrendConfig()
	else:
		system.perspective.openPopup(
			id="AdhocTrendToolBar",
			view="98_Configuration/AdhocTrend/_Assets/ToolBar",
			params={"faceplateShell": False},
			position={"left": 280, "top": 110},
			draggable=True,
			resizable=False,
			showCloseIcon=False,
			modal=True,
			overlayDismiss=False,
			viewportBound=False
		)

# Append empty plot and reassign plain list so Perspective bindings refresh.
	self.session.custom.AdhocTrend.plots = shared.AdhocTrend.apply_add_plot(self.session.custom.AdhocTrend)

# Default Adhoc Trend Config
	default_config = {
		"tags": [],
		"colors": [
			"#008FFB",
			"#34C759",
			"#FFA726",
			"#FF4560",
			"#775DD0",
			"#1C4E80",
			"#008080",
			"#26C6DA",
			"#4F4F4F",
			"#6C757D"
		],
		"realtime": True,
		"timeRange": 1,
		"pointCount": 120,
		"chartType": "line",
		"aggregate": "Average",
		"trendId": "",
		"trendName": "",
		"username": "",
		"isShared": True,
		"plots": shared.AdhocTrend.default_plots(),
		"penPlots": {},
		"startDate": system.date.addHours(system.date.now(), -8),
		"endDate": system.date.now()
	}
	self.session.custom.AdhocTrend = default_config
	self.view.custom.trendId = ""

transforms.code:
instances = []
	plots = shared.AdhocTrend.plain_plots(value)
	n = len(plots)
	for p in plots:
		instances.append({
			"instanceStyle": {"classes": ""},
			"instancePosition": {"grow": 1, "shrink": 1, "basis": "0px"},
			"plotId": p["id"],
			"plotTitle": p["title"],
			"plotKind": p["kind"],
			"plotCount": n,
		})
	return instances
